title: P6A Retail Transaction Completion
businessRules: Active company PAYMENT_METHOD master data is authoritative for new tenders; inactive methods remain historical only and cannot settle new sales.
Every payment/refund preserves immutable tender identity and accounting-policy snapshot so later master edits cannot rewrite historical financial meaning.
Server remains authoritative for exact split totals, cash-change eligibility, provider/reference requirements, offline eligibility, explicit on-account amount and refund allocation.
All settlement, clearing, MDR/fee and receivable postings reuse canonical Accounting Core; no parallel payment or accounting ledger is permitted.
On-account sale requires an explicit customer and explicit amount; unpaid value cannot masquerade as paid, and later customer receipt settlement is bounded and idempotent.
Gift/store-credit/customer-wallet and layaway are not claimed without a durable concurrency-safe canonical balance/lifecycle; browser-only or status-only substitutes are forbidden.

P6A is an engineering-wave label only and does not advance canonical product currentPhase; productReady=false, currentPhase=P5 and Human Stage-20=PENDING remain unchanged until their own acceptance gates pass.
acceptanceCriteria: POS and sale API consume active PAYMENT_METHOD authority instead of a fixed CASH/QRIS/TRANSFER/CARD business list while retaining legacy history compatibility.
Tender configuration distinguishes settlement account/behavior, provider/reference requirements, refund policy, offline eligibility, cash-change permission and optional MDR/fee accounting.
Multiple dynamic tenders settle one sale only when the server-validated total exactly equals tender due; idempotent retries cannot duplicate payment/accounting facts.
Explicit customer on-account sales create journal-backed AR and later customer receipts remain bounded by outstanding balance and idempotent.
Refund/reversal allocation uses immutable original tender/AR facts and cannot exceed committed original tender/receivable capacity.
Admin manages real tender policy; POS uses real backend tender authority; shift/read models distinguish tender, clearing and MDR/net-settlement truth.
Existing Browser UAT remains fail-closed and additionally exercises runtime tender authority, split payment and on-account operator paths.
testPlan: Run node --test tests/p6a-retail-transaction-completion.test.mjs and directly affected POS/offline/refund/accounting regression suites.
Run SQLite and PostgreSQL expand-migration rehearsals and verify legacy Payment rows remain readable after additive snapshot/accounting fields.
Run sale/return inventory movement regression proving P6A does not duplicate, bypass or silently alter canonical stock movement/reversal semantics.
Assert every P6A journal remains balanced debit=credit and is posted through Accounting Core with no direct duplicate journal creation.
Run offline/retry tests proving dynamic allowOffline policy is enforced and split/on-account flows remain fail-closed where unsupported.
Run workflow:validate, validate:repo, test:dependency-free, lint/build, recovery/full/UI audits, uat:pre-github:local and git diff --check before the single delivery commit.
migrationPlan: Use registered additive expand migration T360-20261005-p6a-retail-transaction-completion for SQLite and PostgreSQL. Historical payment/refund facts are preserved; no destructive reset/db-push or historical rewrite is allowed.
rollbackPlan: Rollback application code first while leaving additive P6A columns in place. Never delete historical tender/refund snapshots or destructively reverse posted journals; use canonical reversal/compensating operations for posted financial effects.
monitoringPlan: Monitor sale/payment validation failures, split-total mismatch, on-account outstanding/receipt bounds, refund allocation errors, journal-balance guards, offline replay conflicts and settlement/MDR read-model discrepancies.
securityNotes: All P6A mutations remain authenticated and tenant/company/branch scoped, use existing permission/idempotency/audit boundaries, never store card credentials, and treat provider/reference values as business metadata only.
notes: Governance record for the P6A engineering wave that began from exact automated-green baseline eb320e931f898acdcce4b705ca4dd6e51059d156. It intentionally does not advance canonical currentPhase while P5/Human Stage-20 acceptance remains pending.
